age_limit.details: Maximum Age Limit: 45 years. Relaxation in upper age limit is applicable in cases of horizontal reservation as per GoI rules. | To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

qualification.details: Bachelor's degree in Commerce (B.Com) from a recognized University/Institute. Proficiency in accounting software (such as Tally/ERP systems), MS Office (especially Excel), and financial reporting. Minimum 3 years of post-qualification experience in accounting, financial management, budget monitoring, utilization certificates in Government organizations, Autonomous Bodies, Universities, Research Institutions, or reputed private organizations. Sound knowledge of statutory compliance, GST, TDS, income tax regulations, and financial audit procedures.

how_to_apply: Applications must be submitted online on or before 22-09-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Hyderabad to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Hyderabad Accountant recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of online applications is 22 September 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Accountant post?
faq.answer: A Bachelor's degree in Commerce (B.Com) from a recognized University/Institute is required. Proficiency in accounting software and MS Office is also essential.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Accountant position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Accountant post is 45 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per Government of India rules for certain categories.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Accountant role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 40,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Accountant post?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Written Test, followed by a Skill Test, and an Interview.

faq.question: Q7. How many vacancies are available for the Accountant post?
faq.answer: There is only one vacancy available for the Accountant post in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What type of job is this recruitment?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity at the Indian Institute of Technology Hyderabad.

faq.question: Q9. What is the minimum experience required for the Accountant position?
faq.answer: A minimum of 3 years of post-qualification experience in accounting and financial management is required.

faq.question: Q10. Where is IIT Hyderabad located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Hyderabad is located in Hyderabad, Telangana, with the pincode 502284.
